name: Portrait kiosk product detail
describe: Full-screen product detail (product_detail_enabled): the layout header, then ProductDetail: underlined Back, full-width image, h1 20/600 name, muted description, 18/500 rate, Variants and Add-ons option rows, a 36 px round quantity stepper and the full-pill Add to cart button.

Use when a card is tapped and product detail is on. Image height follows the source (natural aspect, w-full). RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels (self-order has no locale file).
